sources.title: DeepSeek-V3-0324 model card
sources.evidence: Exact checkpoint card identifies the developer, MIT weight release, reasoning/code benchmark improvements and function calling. It explicitly says the structure is identical to DeepSeek-V3 and links its implementation.

sources.title: DeepSeek-V3-0324 checkpoint configuration
sources.evidence: DeepseekV3ForCausalLM has 61 main layers, one next-token-prediction layer, 256 routed experts, eight selected experts per token and one shared expert. max_position_embeddings is 163840; the checkpoint uses block-scaled FP8 weights.

sources.title: DeepSeek-V3 Weight File Documentation
sources.evidence: Current guide reports main-model 671B total and 36.7B active; MTP has approximately 11.5B unique and 2.4B active. MTP shares its embedding and output head with the main model. FP8 weight_scale_inv tensors contain dequantization scales.

sources.title: DeepSeek-V3 Technical Report
sources.evidence: The report describes the Transformer using MLA and DeepSeekMoE, nominal 671B/37B counts, and MTP embedding/output-head sharing. MTP can be discarded for ordinary inference or used for speculative decoding. Applied here through the exact checkpoint card's explicit structural-equivalence statement.

sources.title: DeepSeek API Change Log: March 24, 2025
sources.evidence: The dated entry explicitly upgrades deepseek-chat to DeepSeek-V3-0324 on March 24, 2025, with improved reasoning, coding and function calling. This establishes the earlier release date independently of the March 25 news announcement.

sources.title: DeepSeek-V3-0324 Release
sources.evidence: March 25 announcement links the public weights and MIT license, confirms improved tool use, and directs users to disable DeepThink for V3.

sources.title: DeepSeek-V3-0324 LICENSE
sources.evidence: The exact checkpoint repository contains the MIT License, attributed to DeepSeek.

sources.title: DeepSeek-V3 repository README
sources.evidence: The original V3 download table lists nominal 671B total, 37B active and 128K context. These are family architecture figures, qualified here by the exact 0324 configuration and the main/MTP weight guide.

sources.title: DeepSeek-V3-0324 commit history
sources.evidence: Official checkpoint uploads are dated March 24, 2025; a release-documentation commit followed on March 25. The changelog, rather than upload timestamps alone, establishes public availability.

name.note: Catalog display spacing normalizes the official name DeepSeek-V3-0324.

developer.note: Released through the developer's official checkpoint repository.

family.note: The catalog's broad family key covers this explicitly named DeepSeek-V3 revision.

release_date.note: The first-party changelog dates deployment to March 24. The March 25 announcement and documentation commit are later events.

open_weights.note: Official public checkpoint weights are linked from the release announcement.

license.note: The exact 0324 card applies MIT to the repository and weights; the original December V3 model agreement is not this revision's license.

parameters_b.note: Nominal main-model billions, requiring proposed main_model scope. Complete unique checkpoint size is not asserted: MTP adds shared-weight complications, and the Hugging Face 685B display is not an independently verified unique learned-parameter total. No shard totals or scale tensors were counted.

active_parameters_b.note: Guide's approximate main-model active count includes the embedding and output head; the paper/card round this to 37B. MTP activity is separately reported and overlaps shared weights, so it must not be added directly.

architecture.note: Decoder-only Transformer with MLA and DeepSeekMoE; exact configuration confirms expert routing and an auxiliary MTP layer.

context_window.note: Advertised128K context represented as nominal128000, supported by exact card structural equivalence and V3 documentation. Configured max_position_embeddings163840 is a separate ceiling, not the advertised supported window.

modalities.note: Text causal language model with text prompt templates. File-upload and search examples insert extracted text into prompts.

reasoning.note: False denotes absence of the dedicated DeepThink reasoning mode: the release directs users to turn DeepThink off for V3. It does not deny ordinary reasoning ability or the reported benchmark improvements.

tool_call.note: The exact model card explicitly supports function calling and documents improved accuracy.

description.value: March 2025 checkpoint of DeepSeek-V3 with improved reasoning and coding
description.note: Concise paraphrase of the developer's dated update and benchmark comparison with original V3; improvements are developer-reported.

patch.notes: Counts describe the main model: nominal 671B and approximately 36.7B active (37B rounded). The MTP module shares embedding and output weights; the 685B storage headline is not a unique learned total. The guide’s nominal 11.5B MTP figure also differs from tensor-shape accounting, so no complete unique total is asserted. Advertised context is 128K, represented as nominal 128000; configured positions are 163840. Release was March 24; the news announcement followed March 25.

sources.label: Official main-model and MTP weight guide

summary: Audited all 14 fields for the March 24 checkpoint. Verified MIT, MoE and nominal main counts of 671B/36.7B with explicit scope. Shared MTP weights prevent an unqualified full-count assertion. Use advertised 128K context, separate from the configured 163840 positions.
